page.overview:
Who is Danda?

As shops, asks what he thinks about her selection of . If buys all of one type of , calls him strange for needing so many. After buying the last of her , promises to restock soon. When spoken to after this, she comments on how long it took her to procure all of her products. will remark that she has never seen her selection cleared out so completely, before she thanks and tells him that she should now be able to buy her grandchildren some new toys.

While she does sell herself, will also buy them from . On occassion, she will wonder why would sell such high quality . She may also remark that she believes one of her grandchildren will be excited to see what she has bought.
